value.hook: before changing just dev/prod/server recipes, .chainglass/servers, CHAINGLASS_DIST_DIR, or any file a build step generates (prebuild/predev)
value.title: Dev beside prod, prod build copies, and turbo-cached build outputs

sections.name: body
sections.value:
- Servers register per port in .chainglass/servers/<port>.json (mode dev|prod). CLI picks via CG_SERVER_PORT, else discoverServerInfo/listServerInfo. Never read the old single server.json (scripts/chainglass-bell.sh still does; it is dead).
- Prod serves its own copy apps/web/.next-prod-<port> (CHAINGLASS_DIST_DIR). A build is promoted only with a .complete marker (_promote-prod-build keeps .old for rollback), so a `.next` rebuild or a dev server cannot blank prod. Sidecar = PORT+1500; the port claimer never kills a prod sidecar or a recycled pid.
- Every server recipe refuses without apps/web/.env.local (_require-sidecar-env). Fresh worktree: copy it from the main tree and run pnpm install before any server.
- Turbo cache trap: a cache hit on @chainglass/web#build skips prebuild/predev, so anything those generate is missing unless listed in turbo.json build outputs (fixed for public/icons/** in a31aa7976). If you add a generated asset, add it to outputs too. Tests for generated files must fail, not skipIf, when the file is absent; otherwise CI and fresh worktrees silently pass.
- Proving asset loading in a browser: disable the cache (page.setCacheEnabled(false)) and restart the server. A cached tab showed 60 icons and 0 errors while the manifest was 404.
